title: Knee & Calf Aids
description: Knee caps, hinged braces, ROM braces, knee immobilisers, and varicose stockings for comprehensive knee and calf care.

products.name: Knee Cap
features: Elasticated neoprene sleeve with 360° compression
Anatomically shaped for a close, non-slip fit
Smooth inner surface prevents skin abrasion
Slim profile wears comfortably under trousers or sports clothing
benefits: Compresses and warms the knee joint to reduce pain and stiffness
Supports the knee during mild ligament strains and early osteoarthritis
Improves proprioceptive feedback to enhance joint stability
Suitable for daily wear and light sporting activity

products.name: Hinge Knee Cap
features: Neoprene sleeve with bilateral polycentric hinges
Open-patella design reduces pressure on the kneecap
Hinges guide the knee through a controlled range of motion
Anti-migration straps above and below the knee prevent slipping
benefits: Provides mediolateral joint stability for ligament injuries and instability
Reduces pain during weight-bearing in moderate osteoarthritis
Controls knee movement during rehabilitation post-ligament sprain
Suitable for return-to-activity after knee injury

products.name: Polycentric Hinge Knee Cap
features: Dual-axis polycentric hinges replicate the natural knee joint motion
Rigid frame with padded straps for firm support
Adjustable hinge stops to limit or control range of motion
Breathable neoprene shell with moisture-wicking lining
benefits: Delivers superior joint control for moderate-to-severe ligament instability
Protects the knee post-ACL, PCL, or collateral ligament repair
Polycentric hinge reduces shear forces at the joint during walking
Prescribed in post-surgical rehabilitation protocols for faster, safer return to activity

products.name: Elastic Knee Support
features: Graduated compression elastic knit construction
Seamless tube design for uniform pressure distribution
Thin profile allows use inside most footwear
Easy to pull on without fasteners or straps
benefits: Reduces mild knee swelling and joint effusion through compression
Provides gentle proprioceptive support during daily activities
Suitable for chronic knee pain, mild tendinopathy, and general joint protection
Comfortable for long hours of wear in occupational and everyday settings

products.name: Knee Cap with Open Patella
features: Circular aperture offloads direct pressure from the patella
Silicone patellar ring guides the kneecap into the correct tracking groove
Neoprene body retains warmth and delivers lateral compression
Anti-slip inner surface keeps the brace in position during activity
benefits: Relieves anterior knee pain from patellofemoral syndrome and patellar tendinopathy
Corrects patellar maltracking to reduce pain during stair climbing and squatting
Protects the knee after patellar dislocation during rehabilitation
Suitable for patients with chondromalacia patella seeking non-surgical symptom relief

products.name: ROM Knee Brace
features: Adjustable range-of-motion hinges with marked degree settings
Rigid lightweight frame with breathable padded straps
Extension and flexion stops independently adjustable
Universal sizing fits most adult knee circumferences
benefits: Controls range of motion precisely during post-operative rehabilitation
Protects surgical repairs by preventing unwanted joint positions
Allows incremental increases in movement as healing progresses
Standard prescription brace following knee ligament reconstruction and meniscal repair

products.name: Knee Immobilizer
products.sizes: S, M, L, XL, XXL, XXXL (14/19/22 inch)
features: Full-length rigid posterior shell with multiple velcro closures
Foam padding at the popliteal fossa and bony prominences
Available in three length options to match thigh-to-calf measurements
Ventilated design reduces heat build-up during immobilisation
benefits: Completely immobilises the knee for fractures, dislocations, and acute ligament tears
Maintains the knee in extension during transport and early post-injury management
Used post-operatively when full knee immobilisation is prescribed
Reduces pain by preventing any inadvertent knee movement

products.name: Varicose Stocking Below Knee
features: Graduated compression highest at the ankle, decreasing towards the knee
Medical-grade elastic knit fabric maintains compression over extended wear
Reinforced heel and toe zones for durability
Smooth exterior suitable for wear with formal and casual footwear
benefits: Improves venous return from the lower leg to reduce varicose vein symptoms
Reduces ankle and calf swelling from venous insufficiency and prolonged standing
Prevents deep vein thrombosis during long-haul travel or bed rest
Supports post-sclerotherapy and post-varicose vein surgery recovery

products.name: Varicose Stocking Above Knee
features: Full-leg graduated compression from foot to thigh
Silicone stay-up band at the thigh prevents rolling or slipping
Breathable, moisture-wicking fabric for all-day comfort
Reinforced foot panel for durability
benefits: Manages thigh-level varicosities and extensive venous insufficiency
Reduces whole-leg oedema and heaviness caused by poor venous circulation
Prescribed post-deep vein thrombosis to prevent post-thrombotic syndrome
Suitable for patients with lymphoedema requiring full lower limb compression
